Name: Apply MSAA policy
Description: Fixed requests the chosen sample count within the current native limit. Maximum retains native reductions while capping its next normal decision. 1 sample means no multisample AA. Resizes and replay frames remain native.
RestoreBehavior: Disable or disconnect resumes native adaptation at later normal frame decisions. The resident hook remains; no save or configuration change.

Evidence.Finding: Fixed requests the chosen sample count within the current native limit. Maximum retains native reductions while capping its next normal decision. 1 sample means no multisample AA. Resizes and replay frames remain native.
Evidence.Level: Complete native ASM/original bytes and isolated execution/guard tests; live graphics not tested.

Name: Resume native MSAA
Description: Resume the game's automatic MSAA choice. The sample count can take several frames to change.
RestoreBehavior: Disable or disconnect resumes native adaptation at later normal frame decisions. The resident hook remains; no save or configuration change.

Evidence.Finding: Disables the policy. Native adaptation can take several frames; this does not force a particular sample count. The installed pass-through hook stays resident.
Evidence.Level: Complete native ASM/original bytes and isolated execution/guard tests; live graphics not tested.

Name: Active MSAA policy
Description: Current policy: Native, Fixed or Maximum. A lost connection or a replaced renderer disables the override.
RestoreBehavior: Disable or disconnect resumes native adaptation at later normal frame decisions. The resident hook remains; no save or configuration change.

Evidence.Finding: 0 native, 1 Fixed, 2 Maximum. Connection or renderer lifetime loss disables the active policy.
Evidence.Level: Complete native ASM/original bytes and isolated execution/guard tests; live graphics not tested.

Name: Requested samples
Description: Sample count requested by the active policy. The current native hardware limit can reduce it.
RestoreBehavior: Disable or disconnect resumes native adaptation at later normal frame decisions. The resident hook remains; no save or configuration change.

Evidence.Finding: Sample count requested by the active policy. The current native hardware limit can reduce it.
Evidence.Level: Complete native ASM/original bytes and isolated execution/guard tests; live graphics not tested.

Name: Native MSAA limit
Description: Current negotiated sample capability after the native vendor restriction. This is a limit, not a graphics-quality preference.
RestoreBehavior: Disable or disconnect resumes native adaptation at later normal frame decisions. The resident hook remains; no save or configuration change.

Evidence.Finding: Current negotiated sample capability after the native vendor restriction. This is a limit, not a graphics-quality preference.
Evidence.Level: Complete native ASM/original bytes and isolated execution/guard tests; live graphics not tested.

Name: Current native samples
Description: Sample count chosen for the current normal frame. Replay frames can temporarily use a previously recorded value.
RestoreBehavior: Disable or disconnect resumes native adaptation at later normal frame decisions. The resident hook remains; no save or configuration change.

Evidence.Finding: Current normal-frame exponent converted to samples. Native replay may temporarily use historical attachment states.
Evidence.Level: Complete native ASM/original bytes and isolated execution/guard tests; live graphics not tested.

Name: Last native proposal
Description: Last validated normal-frame native quality decision before applying the policy. Unavailable until such a decision is observed.
RestoreBehavior: Disable or disconnect resumes native adaptation at later normal frame decisions. The resident hook remains; no save or configuration change.

Evidence.Finding: Last validated normal-frame native quality decision before applying the policy. Unavailable until such a decision is observed.
Evidence.Level: Complete native ASM/original bytes and isolated execution/guard tests; live graphics not tested.

Name: Last policy result
Description: Last sample count selected by the active policy. The game applies resource changes during its normal rendering update.
RestoreBehavior: Disable or disconnect resumes native adaptation at later normal frame decisions. The resident hook remains; no save or configuration change.

Evidence.Finding: Last validated normal-frame quality decision returned by the active policy. The native caller owns resource changes.
Evidence.Level: Complete native ASM/original bytes and isolated execution/guard tests; live graphics not tested.

Name: MSAA control status
Description: Shows whether MSAA controls are installed or a fault requires a game restart. A partial installation is not retried.
RestoreBehavior: Disable or disconnect resumes native adaptation at later normal frame decisions. The resident hook remains; no save or configuration change.

Evidence.Finding: 0 absent, 1 resident, 2 fault. A fault requires a game restart; the trainer will not retry a partial installation.
Evidence.Level: Complete native ASM/original bytes and isolated execution/guard tests; live graphics not tested.
